killedBy: devSearchFrom: BUILDING a developer URL (issue #623) is a FIXED POINT of the canonicaliser, so the two cannot disagree about a selection
why: Moves the bundle after the registry fields, so a built URL is no longer what `canonicalDevSearch` would produce for the same selection. Every flag still parses identically -- order is meaningless to `URLSearchParams` -- so nothing about BEHAVIOUR changes and only the fixed-point property notices. It matters because Copy Link and Apply and Reload would then emit different strings for the same choices, and a URL a developer shares would not match the one the menu shows.
